CustomField.description: Non-standard subprocessor obligations that go beyond simple advance notice: prior written consent / approval rights, tiered or longer advance-notice periods (e.g. 6 months for Service Providers with data access), or objection/opt-out rights. Null when the contract only requires standard advance notice (the Subprocessor_Notice_Period__c day count captures that case). Populated even when Subprocessor_Notice_Period__c falls back to the default of 30.
CustomField.label: Subprocessor Restrictions
